summary_en: This study tests Allo-QuadCAR01-T, an off-the-shelf CAR-T cell therapy made from donor cells, in adults with relapsed or refractory B-cell cancers, including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. Participants get chemotherapy with cyclophosphamide and fludarabine by IV over 3 days, then one IV infusion of the study therapy on Day 1, and are followed for up to 15 years. The main outcomes are safety and complete response rate at Week 13, and the study is Phase 1/2.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa Allo-QuadCAR01-T, una terapia CAR-T lista para usar elaborada con células de donante, en adultos con cánceres de células B recidivantes o refractarios, incluido el linfoma difuso de células B grandes. Los participantes reciben quimioterapia con ciclofosfamida y fludarabina por vía intravenosa durante 3 días, luego una sola infusión intravenosa del tratamiento del estudio el Día 1, y se les da seguimiento por hasta 15 años. Los resultados principales son la seguridad y la tasa de respuesta completa en la Semana 13, y el estudio es de Fase 1/2.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma or chronic lymphocytic leukemia
Received at least 2 prior lines of therapy
Adequate heart, liver and kidney function, and HLA B/C match with donor cells
not_for: Active CNS involvement, including PCNSL, in dose escalation cohorts
CAR-T within 3 months of screening, or Grade 3 or higher ICAHT from prior CAR-T
Prior allogeneic stem cell transplant or solid organ transplant
History of GvHD or post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder
